text.p: Emmis Broadcasting Corp said Thursday it continues to seek merger and acquisition opportunities.

"I will say again that our patience and prudence should not be confused with complacency in this area," Jeff Smulyan, chairman, said in a statement. "Our goal is not necessarily to own the most stations, but rather to find opportunities to enhance our position and create maximum shareholder value."
Earlier, Emmis reported a profit for the fourth quarter ended February 28 of $0.11 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.01.
Broadcast cash flow for the quarter increased to $8.8 million from $6.9 million a year ago. For the fiscal year, broadcast cash flow was $50.5 million, up from $45.9 million.
Emmis operates several radio stations and publishes two city magazines, Indianapolis Monthly and Atlanta.
